reset_memory_cuda: reset cuda memory by collecting garbage, emptying cache, and resetting peak and accumulated memory stats for a device
print_memory_usage: print cuda memory allocated, max allocated, and max reserved in GB for a given device
reset_and_print_memory: reset cuda memory stats then print current, max allocated, and max reserved memory for a device
monitor_gpu_memory: monitor gpu memory usage by printing allocated and reserved memory statistics in GB
cleanup_cuda_resources: cleanup cuda resources by garbage collecting, emptying cache, and resetting memory statistics
